Convert the 6 CCD walkthrough skills to agent-agnostic form. The 9 guides (guides/) are the SINGLE content HTML the skills point at; the old per-skill walkthrough_html beats + beat_scripts.md + starter_deck.md RETIRE. Content single-sourced in the guides => a beadwork update is one HTML edit (the steward loop bws-vk0 files those tickets). Skill edited only when *presentation* changes.

Do beadwork-overview first as the TEMPLATE for PRINCIPAL review, then replicate to the other 5 (as-memory, as-bus, for-decisions, for-meta-analysis [needs a real agent-agnostic meta page], install).
title: Convert beadwork skills to agent-agnostic (thin SKILL.md + guides as single content)
